commits.body:
A null array and a negative offset or count can have two different Java exceptions. Both native engines now consult the selected bootstrap constructor, including the exception's own bytecode in Java 8. A check without runtime bytes refuses the ambiguous case. Five real JVMs and five strict native probes agreed: Java 8 reported bounds, bounds, null while Java 11, 17, 21 and 25 reported null three times. All 18 values tests and the 43 changed-test suites passed.

Freeze two separate transfer cases: Eclipse Collections' 2,865 bounded insertions and JavaParser's two traversal shapes with identity and exhaustion controls. Historical build jobs 20261121-102122-359 and 20261121-102122-360 replace the first attempts, which reached the unrelated Eclipse P2 plugin and the incompatible Java 21 SequencedCollection API respectively. Their JDK 17 builds supply original JARs for JDK 21 observations. Jobs starting 20261121-102303 through 20261121-102305 repeat all primary native and finite checks and both Lang selector proofs on this tree.

Recount actual test XML and original bytecode receipts, including Surefire's named assertion source lines when malformed UTF-16 truncates its XML stack message. The ordered Hadoop run finished all ten finite obligations and reached real external initialization in both strict routes. The scorecard independently reconstructed 36 of 46 native and 46 of 46 finite outcomes ahead of the final repeat.

Both complete public JVM grids match the independent fixed oracle. The original strict parser reaches the line.separator property, and a separately observed startup reaches an unbound enum object.

Re-run its public control, verify every byte against the complete digest from the original receipt, and retain whole JSON rows in small files. Both 2,865-row streams were reassembled, a changed byte and a truncation were rejected. The primary repeat at 88866c1d still qualified 36/46 strict native and 46/46 finite obligations. Jobs 20261121-105255 through 20261121-105257 recheck the eight pairs and the language selector proofs on this product. Job 20261121-104615 tests proof reuse across the changed String model.

commits.summary: Replay native selector candidates against the original JVM before grading them (verification pending)
commits.body:
Eclipse Collections' original insertion at selector 940 returned the wrong result in the native checker. Replaying that constant wrapper in the interpreter was enough to find the candidate, but the selector workflow stopped before invoking its own independent JVM checker. It now sends a reproduced interpreter candidate to the public original entry and requires the exact selector, bytecode, classpath, claim and JDK to match. A missing or different JVM replay cannot qualify a refutation.

All 11 recipe tests passed, including a damaged or missing original replay, and all 42 changed-test suites passed. The original failed wrapper reports remain available. Job 20261121-111009-359-replay-the-native-selector-witnesses exercises both reported parent failures on the actual Eclipse Collections artifact.

commits.summary: Publish the original Java PR scorecard and its independently replayable evidence
commits.body:
On the six primary upstream PRs, strict native verification advanced from 17/46 obligations to 36/46, including ten parent refutations replayed on the original JVM. Five complete PRs now close natively instead of one. Finite execution advanced from 36/46 to 46/46, with all eight named historical tests failing on the parent and passing on the fix and all 3,658 fixed input rows matching their independent oracles. Avro remains open natively at Hadoop or Avro startup, with both factory and direct results retained.

The two separately scored transfer cases add 16 complete finite obligations and eight strict native decisions. Eclipse Collections' full list contents held at all 2,865 original inputs. JavaParser reproduces the empty-root failure on the parent, and the original strict path still needs the process property and the initialized enum object's state. All 62 obligations have discoverable finite proofs and the strict results and execution journals are available from the normal handoff.

The Markdown report and machine scorecard bind revisions, original JAR and class hashes, domain sizes, original observations, dates and execution costs to their receipts. Both Eclipse selector-940 candidates qualified through a fresh JVM on their original artifact. The targeted proof-cache regression also passed. Recounted the scorecard twice, regenerated the router, validated all eight examples with a fresh replay and checked every handoff; all 42 changed-test suites passed.
